messages:
maria: incident-bot fired PagerDuty for route-proxy latency (p95) at 3309998888 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-45231 triggered for service=route-proxy, threshold=latency_p95>2200ms, period=2m
ops-bot: Auto-suppression policy applied: similar-pages window=3m, suppression_remaining=90s :information_source:
jamal: acked PD-45231 3309998890 — checking graphs now
kevin: seeing short burst on proxy egress to redis shard b, latency spike ~60s then drop. looks like kv warmup or perf jitter
maria: any customer-facing errors? support-bot, can you check error rates / 5xx?
support-bot: no uptick in user-facing 5xx in last 10m. session-loss metric flat. only internal tail-latency spike in route-proxy
jamal: running quick query: `SELECT percentile(latency,95) FROM metrics WHERE service='route-proxy' AND shard='b' SINCE 5m` — p95 peaked at 2300ms then back to 180ms
kevin: rolling logs for shard b: found repeated connection timeouts to redis instance redis-b-3 for ~45s starting 3309998878. pattern: TCP retransmits, then recovered. pasted snippet:
```
May 12 03:14:38 route-proxy[1]: WARN redis-b-3 conn timeout after 2500ms
May 12 03:14:39 route-proxy[1]: DEBUG reconnecting to redis-b-3
May 12 03:15:20 route-proxy[1]: INFO connection established to redis-b-3
```
maria: good find. is redis-b-3 on the dedicated cluster or shared?
kevin: it's on the shared read-replica pool in us-west-2. ops metrics show small network flake in that AZ at the same time.
jamal: since it's transient and auto-resolved, we should mark PD incident as noise but note for follow-up — set severity=low, record root cause guess=AZ network blip affecting redis read-replicas
maria: agreed. I'll add runbook notes. jamal, please handoff to next on-call in case it reappears in the hour
jamal: handing off to kevin (next) — I'm clear after confirming recovery and no customer impact
kevin: thanks — I'll keep an eye for 30m. suggested follow-up: add soft-KV-prefill for warm paths and extend retry backoff for redis-b connections. also consider routing fallback to other replica earlier
support-bot: customer impact: none detected. ticket auto-note updated: "no customer-facing errors; transient redis connectivity blip in us-west-2; page auto-resolved"
maria: filing a quick postmortem note in #postmortems later. tagging infra-team to review redis instance health and AZ network telemetry :checkered_flag: 
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-45231 resolved at 3309998902 — auto-resolved by suppression policy (duration=14s active, suppressed after 90s window)
jamal: closing thread here. if anyone sees repeats, reopen or reassign PD. :thumbsup:
kevin: ack. adding follow-up task to infra backlog: "investigate us-west-2 transient network blip + KV warmup mitigation"
maria: thanks team, nice quick mitigation and ops handoff.
